synopsis: CropCraft is an open-source Blender and Python tool for procedurally generating agricultural fields, identified in Chapter 5 as dated November 2025 [f3787, f16006, f16238]. Its reported average simulation-to-real mIoU gap was 9.9%, with gaps of 10.6% on Real Montoldre and 9.2% on Real Steininger [f3731, f4141]. CropCraft also found in 2025 that adding even a few real images to synthetic data improves generalization [f4100]. The corpus includes CropCraft among examples supporting procedural generation’s strong off-road record, but explicitly warns that these agricultural examples do not prove applicability to heavy construction-machine braking [f4194, f4148].

relations.note: Both report the same 9.9% average simulation-to-real mIoU gap.
Both identify CropCraft as an open-source agricultural-field generator.
Its Python tooling supports the glossary’s classification as Python-driven.
Agricultural-field generation substantiates CropCraft’s role in the glossary’s scene-generator grouping.
Reported agricultural procedural-generation results contribute evidence to the claimed off-road record.
Limits the strong off-road record: agricultural examples do not establish construction-machine braking applicability.
Adds a generalization-improvement finding alongside the measured simulation-to-real gaps.
